description:
What a raw item is about, supplied at intake by the source system (never parsed from a filename or cell).

Ties a document (e.g. a project estimation workbook) to the project or opportunity it belongs to. The reference is a
governed external reference, not a graph key; the canonical Project entity is resolved later by a reviewed mapping.

revision_label.description: Supplied stage label, e.g. 'Round 1'. Never inferred from content.
revision_label.title: Revision Label

subject_namespace.description: Issuing system of the reference, e.g. erp.project, crm.opportunity.
subject_namespace.title: Subject Namespace

subject_ref.description: Reference value as issued by that system.
subject_ref.title: Subject Ref

title: IntakeBinding
